limits: Forecast is not execution or occupancy. Redundant flag-only acquisition designs are excluded from useful demand, while preserved in immutable forest.
method: Maximum observed fit CPU per training label and nonfit CPU by history or evidence family, plus measured independent review, multiplied by 1.35 for wall forecast. Dispatch estimates only.
refill_disposition: Ranked expansion improves finite-universe coverage and capped loss across all five nonzero candidate budgets at 32768 labels. Select the six registered 2048-label first-fit budgets to measure sample efficiency, and six 32768-label second fits to test fit sensitivity with repeated fits nested inside each world. Correction and retraction help while irrelevant updates harm at both 32768 and 131072 labels. Select the nine remaining G6 designs: both fits at 128, 512 and 2048 labels, plus second fits at 8192, 32768 and 131072, to locate low-data dependence and test whether the correction/harm contrast is stable across the two frozen fits. These are substantive within-forest continuations of observed effects, not extra seeds for occupancy or confirmation. Criteria, models and resource limits remain unchanged.
